decision_kind_requirements.BATTLE_TERMINAL: Stage-declared terminal reason/status, candidate permissions empty and no unresolved owned settlement; actor/turn/root null after settled terminal transaction
decision_kind_requirements.BUDGET_YIELD: Resumable exact revision/phase/cursor with no new semantic claim; candidates empty, input_request reports which deterministic budget was exhausted
decision_kind_requirements.ENEMY_AI_DECISION: ENABLED live MONSTER_AI participant and exact selected turn; provider request/input populated, candidate permissions explicit; do not auto-pick from local actions if provider absent
decision_kind_requirements.OUT_OF_TURN_WINDOW: Explicit insertion/interrupt availability policy and owner; window input request/safe point if active root, no implicit ultimate rights from energy balance alone
decision_kind_requirements.PENDING_FORCED_ACTION: Exactly one admitted forced request/owner/action permission identified; driver pauses to report it, then explicit caller auto-submit policy may progress; no fabricated choice
decision_kind_requirements.PLAYER_NORMAL_TURN: ENABLED live PLAYER participant, normal ActiveTurn DECISION, actor/turn populated, no running action root or unresolved start/before work; permissions freshly validated
decision_kind_requirements.SEMANTIC_GAP: TypedFailure populated with exact owner/source/resume; candidates empty; stage or actor unknown cannot masquerade as terminal/decision
decision_kind_requirements.SUSPENDED_ACTION_INPUT: Exact active turn/action root and serialized input/barrier request; candidate permissions empty unless same input policy explicitly defines them; AV frozen
decision_kind_requirements.invalidation: Any committed actor/provider/resource/target/readiness/listener mutation increments turn-state revision and invalidates prior permissions/decision receipt. Preview and repeated same-boundary reads are pure.
decision_kind_requirements.priority: Existing unresolved gap/input/owned action drain first; terminal only after settlement; forced/inserted request policy before next normal selection; external actor decision never auto-executed without policy.

enemy_stage_interfaces.LifecycleProvider: Explicit actor/entity revision transitions: defeat/remove cancel waiting entries and invalid owned insertions; active work settles under declared policy; revival creates new generation; summons allocate unique stable IDs/ordinal and full explicit binding.
enemy_stage_interfaces.MonsterDecisionProvider: request(decision_id, actor_id, canonical_snapshot, permissions, policy_hash) -> selected permission + targets + explicit RNG changes or typed gap. No wall-clock/client dependency. AI remains unimplemented.
enemy_stage_interfaces.StageProvider: reconcile(snapshot, settled_boundary_id) -> CONTINUE | WAVE_PENDING | REGISTER_WAVE(participants, source refs) | TERMINAL(reason) | gap. Wave transition only at quiescent boundary, explicit carry/reset clock/modifier/resource policy required.
enemy_stage_interfaces.Wave_policy: This reference profile carries AV clock and survivor due values; new-wave actors full interval at now. Complete wave engine, defeat handling and terminal rules are caller/provider work, not supplied native behavior.

injectable_policy_interface.advance_delay_adjustment: (now, due_at, speed, kind, operand, source_ref) -> due_at Rational under declared basis
injectable_policy_interface.binding: Seven required operation_bindings resolve through a caller-supplied deterministic registry keyed by provider_id/version/implementation_hash. No serialized Python callables or object identity. Unknown provider/hash returns AV_REFERENCE_POLICY_MISSING.
injectable_policy_interface.conformance: Numeric fields/order in this profile are declared requirements. A replacement hook must conform to them, or use a new fully serialized policy profile/schema version that states changed requirements. Registry identity and full parameters participate in stable_hash.
injectable_policy_interface.elapsed_time_advancement: (now Rational, selected due Rational, phase) -> new_now Rational >= now; reference profile freezes action execution
injectable_policy_interface.initial_initiative_placement: (participant ref, now Rational, interval Rational, explicit inputs) -> due_at Rational >= now
injectable_policy_interface.purity: Hooks consume canonical values and produce candidate values, never mutate external stores or depend on wall clock/process floating state; bounds and cross-field validators apply before atomic commit.
injectable_policy_interface.remaining_time_update: (now Rational, due_at Rational) -> nonnegative Rational; pure derived read, not an independent writable field
injectable_policy_interface.spec_hashes: The R21 example hashes identify declared specifications only; R22 must replace them with validated implementation identities when code exists, and store that complete policy in runtime snapshot. They are not fake native/code hashes.
injectable_policy_interface.speed_change_rebase: (now, old_due, old_speed, new_speed, participation/active phase) -> new_due or deferred resample instruction
injectable_policy_interface.speed_to_action_interval: (positive speed Rational, numeric parameters) -> positive Rational
injectable_policy_interface.tie_break: (two eligible entries and immutable participant metadata) -> -1/0/1 with strict total order after final id key; pure, no RNG or container order

integration_call_graph: BehaviorRuntime opt-in global driver -> lifecycle/stage status provider -> queue select -> ActiveTurn START_BOUNDARY
Boundary dispatcher -> existing R17 listeners / EventIR -> existing R15-owned boundary root -> drain -> DECISION
Explicit PLAYER or MonsterAI provider -> ActionPermission -> submit_action -> BEFORE_ACTION boundary drain
Existing ResourceEngine cost transaction + ActorRuntimeBinding context -> BehaviorRuntime.start_action -> ActionExecutionRoot
R15 tasks/children/continuations/events -> R17 / R18 / R19 / R20 settlement -> exact root result
ACTION_REFERENCE_COMPLETE -> AFTER_ACTION -> TURN_END -> duration/expiry -> readiness reset -> stage/lifecycle reconciliation -> next selection
SUSPENDED_INPUT / external barrier -> SUSPENDED_ACTION_INPUT; WAITING_SCHEDULER without input -> ACTION_NOT_COMPLETE; SemanticGap -> SEMANTIC_GAP; no normal AV advance

interrupt_adapter_contract.child: Future adapter starts new root without weakening public local legality guard; binds its distinct category/owner. All parent work is filtered by root id while suspended.
interrupt_adapter_contract.current_limit: Existing R15 start_action calls local legal_actions and rejects an active root. R21/R22 initial policy returns INTERRUPT_POLICY_MISSING.
interrupt_adapter_contract.failure: Unimplemented adapter, absent safe token, active transaction or unknown cancel policy yields typed gap; never reset or overwrite parent queues
interrupt_adapter_contract.future_safe_point: Adapter must expose a serialized safe-point token only between committed task transitions with no open resource/damage transaction. Approval requires caller policy, not native name guesses.
interrupt_adapter_contract.resume: After child and its policy-defined boundaries drain, restore exact parent current_root and context. Child commits remain in shared actor/resource/modifier state; do not restore whole battle snapshot.
interrupt_adapter_contract.save: Atomically mark parent ACTION_SUSPENDED, retain current_root/target_context, all parent queues/frame cursors/events, turn and action root ids.

invariants: Every rational is reduced by gcd; denominator positive; zero is 0/1; no bool/float admitted as numeric input. Compare by integer cross-products.
Native R12 tagged raw values are not decoded as speed; ordinary mode0 positive signed int64 raw/2^33 is explicit adapter scope. Unsupported numeric modes return a gap.
Rational n,d and cross-products obey explicit max_integer_bits; reject overflow atomically as SEMANTIC_GAP before state mutation; no truncation or global floating-point context.
Actor id is a stable string, entity_ref joins existing entities; unique registration ordinal never reused; resurrection/removal increments generation and invalidates stale entries/permissions.

Actor properties/resources/progression/modifiers remain authoritative in existing stores. SpeedSample is a read-only scheduling cache bound to provider revision and input hash, not a second writable speed.
Participation is scheduler membership, not a duplicate HP/alive flag. Entity status comes from explicit lifecycle adapter and matching entity_revision.
Enabled waiting actor has exactly one current normal entry. Active NORMAL_TURN removes its entry until settled. Disabled/removed actor has no selectable entry.
due_at is the sole readiness authority; remaining=max(0,due_at-clock.now) is derived, never a second stored writable AV.

normal_queue is canonically sorted by policy comparator. initiative due_at and normal entry due_at must match with identical revision; mutations atomically update both. Queue is a validated index, not independent AV state.
Priority numbers are reference only; UTF8 byte order is the final total-order tie. Arrays preserve semantic order; maps are canonically key-sorted.
No R15 logical_time or WaitSecond value is added to clock.now. Running/suspended action freezes AV unless an explicit future interruption policy admits work at the same timestamp.
Active stack empty admits a normal selection. With active stack, only top frame owns R15 current_root; suspended parent retains every task/event/continuation ownership identifier.
Permissions bind decision/turn/actor/action IR hash/targets/state_revision/policy_hash; stale/foreign/dead-owner requests reject without cost or RNG draw.
Completion must be ACTION_REFERENCE_COMPLETE for the exact bound root after owned work drain. SkillPerformFinish request, empty local queue or waiting status alone is insufficient.

A root completion is consumed once; duplicate settle commands reject. Source task prefix commits persist on a resumable gap; failed turn transition/boundary effect rolls back only its atomic candidate.
Boundary events carry stable id, dispatch/drain status and emitted listener ids/cursors. Snapshot at any phase resumes exactly once; never redispatch a committed event or decrement duration twice.

Persistent modifiers survive root completion; turn-end duration updates visit live instance IDs in explicit registration order, skip newly created instances for that owner turn, expire only after callbacks drain.
Unknown entity/stage/AI availability/native ordering is not a no-op. Policy absence emits typed gaps; absence differs from explicit empty-listener policy.
All counters/next ids, pending queues, stack, boundaries, provider revisions, policy identities/hashes, terminal/stage and replay cursors serialize; process object identity/wall clock excluded.
State terminal status and BehaviorBattleState.terminal synchronize in one transaction; WAVE_PENDING is not terminal; pending waves prevent victory unless stage policy explicitly declares it.
Budget exhaustion returns BUDGET_YIELD with resumable state. Zero-time transitions, insertion depth and R15 work have separate explicit budgets. No fabricated time tick resolves a cycle.

numeric_operations.advance: advance fraction f>=0 changes due to max(now,due-f*I(current_speed)); not percent remaining
numeric_operations.advance_clock: select eligible minimum due; now=max(now,due); every remaining time is derived from unchanged absolute due; zero elapsed ties still act
numeric_operations.completion: After AFTER_ACTION/TURN_END/duration/expiry callbacks drain, normal due=now+I(final_effective_speed); increment normal cycle/count once. Out-of-turn rule decides AV consumption.
numeric_operations.delay: delay fraction f>=0 changes due to due+f*I(current_speed); negative operands rejected; absolute deltas require different policy id
numeric_operations.disabled: Save remaining distance via remaining time and speed sample; remove normal entry. Re-enable policy is distinct from revival; re-enable uses saved_remaining*s_old/s_new at unchanged clock.
numeric_operations.initial_placement: due=now+I(effective_speed); caller may supply initial due only under a separately hashed placement policy
numeric_operations.interval: I(s)=K/s with K from supplied policy; sample fixture K=10000 is REFERENCE_MODEL, no native constant claim
numeric_operations.revive_summon: Explicit new generation/registration at current now with full interval; removed actor id cannot be silently reused. Native initialization unknown.
numeric_operations.speed_change_active: Update authoritative provider and observed sample; do not reinsert active normal actor. Settlement samples final post-callback speed for next interval.
numeric_operations.speed_change_waiting: At old clock t, r=max(0,due-t); new_due=t+r*s_old/s_new. Apply old sample before replacement, then sort; ready r=0 remains ready.

runtime_apis.adjust_readiness(actor_id, kind, fractio: Execute only under declared basis policy and exact owner/version/authority, append replay command.
runtime_apis.clone/snapshot/stable_hash/replay: Reuse BehaviorRuntime methods; replay new commands through same public APIs and verify each pre/post hash with full policy/catalog/registry identity.
runtime_apis.current_turn_owner() -> actor_id | null: Read owner of top ActiveTurn; normal parent owner stays separately available on interrupt stack. Returns null at idle/terminal, typed gap for unresolved ownership.
runtime_apis.initialize_turns(participant_bindings, p: Validate complete inputs on existing runtime clone; commit mechanics extension only on success.
runtime_apis.is_terminal() -> bool: True only stage-declared VICTORY/DEFEAT/ABORTED; unresolved termination emits gap in drive, not false inferred victory.
runtime_apis.legal_action_candidates(decision_id) ->: Intersect local R15 actions with explicit actor mapping, source cost/resource sufficiency, target and category availability provider. Reference candidates only, no native legal_actions claim.
runtime_apis.next_actor_preview(limit) -> TurnQueueEn: Pure eligible queue preview plus labeled insertion precedence; no RNG, callbacks, AI, mutations, or extrapolated completion beyond current state.
runtime_apis.notify_speed_change(actor_id, provider_r: Atomic rebase from prior cached speed, validate R19 authoritative effective value, invalidate candidate permissions.
runtime_apis.request_insertion(ActionInsertion): Explicit category policy/owner/generation/parent validation. Unsupported interrupt remains typed gap; no R15 child TriggerAbility inferred as a global insertion.
runtime_apis.run_until_decision(budget) -> DecisionBo: Global API added as explicit opt-in path or facade over same BehaviorRuntime. Drives boundaries/R15/stage requests, pauses before player/enemy/out-of-turn/forced selection or input; emits terminal/gap/yield distinctly.
runtime_apis.run_until_next_turn(budget) -> DecisionB: Drive current admitted action and all boundaries until the next newly selected normal turn, or earlier unresolved input/AI/gap/terminal/yield. Never auto-select external actor actions.
runtime_apis.submit_action(permission, targets, expec: Revalidate permission; commit selection/context and before-action work; transact existing source cost; start exactly one R15 root after BEFORE_ACTION drains. Root commit may later gap without undoing prior successful tasks.

scope: Implementation-ready extension contract; no production global engine in R21

serialization.canonical: Reuse canonical_json/stable_hash. Extension requires JSON model, reduced rationals, no floats, finite strings, stable unique ids; reject malformed/missing/extra schema fields.
serialization.clone: Existing state/runtime deep copy. Pending roots/interrupt stack/modifiers/resource checkpoints remain isolated.
serialization.equality: Canonical full snapshot equality; equivalent unreduced rationals are rejected rather than producing alternate hashes.
serialization.hash: Full BehaviorRuntime snapshot includes extension, policies, IR catalog/actions/aliases/events and registry identity. Include policy hashes and provider bindings; do not exclude journals or pending ownership.
serialization.replay: Initial full runtime snapshot + ordered command records with prehash/revision/policy + per-command posthash. Restore providers by registered identity/hash; in-memory callable identity is not authority.
serialization.resume: Validate cross-field references, policy hash match, generation/revision, active root ownership and listener cursors before drive. The state command journal stores prehash and arguments only. Per-command posthash lives in an external replay receipt computed after the journal append; it is not stored in the snapshot being hashed.
